description: This file contains SQL functions and triggers for maintaining a denormalized booking data table, including functions to refresh data on booking changes, updates to related event types and user information, and trigger definitions for automatic execution upon data modifications.

methods.name: calculate_is_team_booking
methods.description: Determines if a team booking based on team_id being not null.

methods.name: refresh_booking_time_status_denormalized
methods.description: Refreshes a single booking's denormalized data by deleting existing entry and inserting updated data.

methods.name: trigger_refresh_booking_time_status_denormalized
methods.description: Trigger function to refresh denormalized booking data on insert or update.

methods.name: trigger_delete_booking_time_status_denormalized
methods.description: Trigger function to delete denormalized booking data on booking deletion.

methods.name: refresh_booking_time_status_team_id
methods.description: Updates teamId and isTeamBooking fields in denormalized data when EventType's teamId changes.

methods.name: refresh_booking_time_status_length
methods.description: Updates event length in denormalized data when EventType's length changes.

methods.name: refresh_booking_time_status_parent_id
methods.description: Updates parentId in denormalized data when EventType's parentId changes.

methods.name: trigger_refresh_booking_time_status_denormalized_user
methods.description: Updates user email, name, and username in denormalized data when user info changes.

calls: UPDATE "BookingDenormalized" btsd SET ... WHERE btsd."eventTypeId" = NEW.id
UPDATE "BookingDenormalized" btsd SET ... WHERE btsd."userId" = NEW.id
